xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5169: herdr backend: conversation list still polls tmux capture-pane, and pan up requires tmux

plan.title: herdr backend: conversation list still polls tmux capture-pane, and pan up requires tmux
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: On a Herdr host with no tmux (a Mac without tmux or Homebrew), the dashboard still runs tmux capture-pane for polled conversation pane reads: conversationNeedsTerminal calls tmux directly, claudeConversationPaneChoice captures through tmux on every pending-input feed poll and single read because tmuxPaneText is always null on Herdr, and readConversationInputTarget / readConversationPermission take resolveAgentPaneIo's legacy tmux fallback whenever findHerdrAgentPane returns null. Each failed spawn on macOS leaves ~10 dead processes, per conversation per poll. Separately, pan up's ensureHostTools treats tmux as fatal regardless of backend, runs brew install tmux even when brew is not on PATH, and exits 1.
narratives.Proposal: Add an opt-in legacyTmuxFallback: false option to resolveAgentPaneIo (default unchanged) that throws on a Herdr miss instead of falling back to tmux; use it for the three polled reads (needs-terminal, input-target, pane permission). Skip pane-choice detection inside claudeConversationPaneChoice on a Herdr host when no captured screen is supplied. Make ensureHostTools require tmux only under the tmux backend (warn and continue under Herdr, no install attempt). Guard every darwin brew install behind a spawn-free findExecutableOnPath('brew') check and print a download-URL hint when brew is absent. Update docs/TERMINAL-BACKENDS.md, configuration/terminal-backend.mdx and add changelog.d/pan-5169.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Conversation liveness tmux fallbacks in src/lib/overdeck/conversation-liveness.ts stay unchanged (deliberate PAN-3921 rollback safety; once per poll, not per conversation).
- No host-tool cache or shared PATH-lookup module (PAN-5168 owns it).
- The execSync tmux set-environment loop in src/cli/index.ts after ensureHostTools stays unchanged.
- PREREQ_REGISTRY.spawnAgent and the /api/prereqs route stay unchanged.
- Other capturePane callers under src/dashboard/server/routes/ and services/ stay unchanged.
- User-initiated paths keep the default legacy tmux fallback: answerConversationPermission, the message-send permission hold in conversation-message.ts (it guards ensure-main's keys), the pane-choice answer route, scheduled-message delivery and ensure-main.
- Pane-choice detection is not routed through Herdr (the answer path is tmux-only).
- pan install's prerequisite warning wording in src/cli/commands/install-prereqs.ts stays unchanged.
- The pre-existing installTtyd darwin download fallback is not fixed; only its brew attempt is guarded.
- Tmux-host behavior of every polled conversation read must not change (same session names, same line counts).

autoDecisions.summary: Under Herdr, polled conversation pane reads never fall back to tmux; a pane Herdr does not hold reads as unreadable.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue body and operator comment both say never call tmux under herdr. Consequence recorded: legacy tmux conversations on a Herdr host lose inputTarget (reads 'unknown'), needsTerminal (false), pane permission detection (hook registry still reports) and pane-choice menus.

autoDecisions.summary: Strict reads are an opt-in option (legacyTmuxFallback: false) on resolveAgentPaneIo, default true.
autoDecisions.rationale: User-initiated answer and keying paths share resolveAgentPaneIo and still need the legacy fallback; an option keeps one door (one variant per operation) and existing test mocks that return a fixed io keep working.

autoDecisions.summary: Pane-choice detection is skipped on a Herdr host inside claudeConversationPaneChoice when no capture is supplied, rather than routed through Herdr.
autoDecisions.rationale: The pane-choice answer path is tmux-only (docs/TERMINAL-BACKENDS.md), so a Herdr-detected menu could not be answered; one change covers both the pending-input feed and the single conversation read.

autoDecisions.summary: needsTerminal keeps capturePane(name, 0) on tmux and reads Herdr with source 'visible' and 60 lines.
autoDecisions.rationale: On tmux, scrollback could still hold an answered onboarding screen and falsely flip the view to terminal; no Herdr read uses lines=0 anywhere today.

autoDecisions.summary: Under Herdr, pan up does not try to install a missing tmux; it prints one warning and continues.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches pan install (install-prereqs.ts forgives tmux under herdr) and pan doctor (warns under herdr); installing an unneeded tool at every boot, possibly via sudo, is intrusive.

autoDecisions.summary: brew presence is checked with the existing uncached, spawn-free findExecutableOnPath from src/lib/pan-cli-shim.ts.
autoDecisions.rationale: Operator comment: do not add a second tool cache; PAN-5168 has no commits yet, so there is nothing shared to import; an fs PATH scan avoids the very spawn storm this issue is about.

autoDecisions.summary: The pending-input feed's second (unnamed in the issue) per-conversation tmux leak via claudeConversationPaneChoice is in scope.
autoDecisions.rationale: It is the same class of bug (a polled conversation pane read calling tmux under Herdr) and the largest per-conversation cost on current main.

autoDecisions.summary: The strict permission read is opted into by the two polled callers in conversation-reads.ts, not made the default of readConversationPermission.
autoDecisions.rationale: conversation-message.ts line 619 uses conversationPendingPermission as the hold that stops ensure-main's Down/Enter keys from answering a permission prompt; ensure-main keys through the default fallback, so the guard must read the same pane.

Everything else unchanged; the default keeps the legacy tmux fallback for every existing caller.
